What is CatGenie Whoosh Super Clumping Natural Cat Litter

Made from natural soybean pulp, a byproduct of edible tofu production, this plant-based cat litter is a non-toxic, water-soluble, and flushable alternative to clay litter. The low-dust formula helps keep your home cleaner, while the soft, gentle texture is comfortable for cats with sensitive paws. An eco-friendly litter that’s safe for your cat and easy for you.

Single Bag Weight: 4.92 lbs. (29.52 lbs. total)

6-Pack oF Whoosh Litter and Sanisolution Cartridge should last about 3 Months for 2 cats using the CatGenie Whoosh. (11+/- weeks)

products.body_html:
Add additional peace of mind to your new litter-free life!

CatGenie includes an 18 month Limited Warranty (This option adds an additional year and 6 months of protection.) For a total of 3 years.  Only valid if purchased with CatGenie purchase.

products.title: Washable Granules
products.body_html:
Washable Granules replaces traditional litter in your CatGenie A.I. & 120 with a cat-safe reusable granule that satisfies a cat's need to dig and cover, but never needs to be changed!  Just add Granules whenever the level gets low. That's it!

Each box lasts 2-5 months depending on the number of cats, the consistency of their waste and how much your cats dig in the box.

Washable Granules are made of a dust-free, non-toxic combination of natural and synthetic biodegradable materials that will break down naturally in Septic Systems.

IMPORTANT: NEVER use regular cat litter in the CatGenie A.I.

The Washable Granules are made specially for the CatGenie A.I. & 120. Anything else will damage the unit, clog your pipes, and void your Warranty.

products.title: SaniSolution Cartridge – Scent Free
products.body_html:
This listing is for SCENT FREE SaniSolution Cartridges. If you are looking for Fresh Scent, CLICK HERE.

CatGenie SaniSolution Cartridges dispense the perfect amount of cat-safe, vet-approved cleaning solution during each CatGenie Cleaning Cycle.

The concentrated cleaner inside a SaniSolution Cartridge is made with the same ingredients used by veterinarians to clean their exam and operating areas.

Each Cartridge lasts 240 Cleaning Cycles on Cat Activation Mode or 120 Cleaning Cycles on Manual or Time Activation Modes.

Compatible with CatGenie A.I. and CatGenie 120 models. Available in Fresh Scent and Scent Free varieties.

The CatGenie will not run without a SaniSolution Cartridge, so be sure to always keep extras on hand!

Cartridge Size: 15 Fluid Oz
Cartridge Dimensions: 4" Width x 7" Height x 1.5" Deep
Cartridge Weight: 2 lb

products.title: Machine Washing Soak
products.body_html:
Keep Your CatGenie Running Like New!

CatGenie Machine Washing Soak:

-The CatGenie Machine Washing Soak uses the power of Citric Acid to clean all the nooks and crannies inside your machine and remove lime and mineral deposits with a gentle but effective soak. 
-When diluted for cleaning, the powder is safe for pets, people and plumbing.
-Complete a Machine Washing Soak once every 90 days or as needed to keep your Unit running smoothly.
-Each Pack contains 4 packets, good for 1 Machine Washing Soak each. Not sold separately.
-Packet Size: 3.5oz per packet
 

What do you need to do? Simply dilute the cleaning powder in a bucket of hot water and pour into the Hopper of your CatGenie. Pour additional warm water into the Bowl. Let soak for 2 hours.

You can even dump any collected Granules back into your CatGenie. You'll wonder how you ever had a cat box without it!

GeniePocket Mat measures 21.5" wide and comes out 22" from the front of the CatGenie unit.
